channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Africa, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new fellowship - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• ARUA: Early-Career Research Fellowships 2026 (Option 2)
    https://arua.org/early-career-research-fellowships/
    African Research Universities Alliance (ARUA), with the Mastercard Foundation and Carnegie Corporation of New York · deadline Closed 15 Jul 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 2,000, a modest accommodation payment, and travel support (return ticket to host institution). 6-month fellowship.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
